description: Change main-link access only when requested by the user. private: authorized members only; unlisted: anyone with the link, excluded from discovery by unrelated users; public: public catalog and keyword search. Keeps the same URL and main discussion, creates no independent share. Changing to private does NOT revoke independent links; inspect and revoke those separately when asked to stop all sharing. If this fails after creation, retry this operation, never republish.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_set_visibility
title: Set main-link access
